Account B (Palmdale Health) is larger historically but its delivery ends after Feb 2026 with no data in Mar-Jul 2026, indicating it was wound down. The client appears to have migrated to the new Account A around Feb 2026. Per brief instructions the two accounts are NOT combined; the case study is built solely on the active Account A.

queries.monthly_trend: SELECT segments.year, segments.month, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.conversions, metrics.all_conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.year, segments.month
queries.conversion_actions: SELECT conversion_action.name, conversion_action.type, conversion_action.category, conversion_action.status FROM conversion_action WHERE conversion_action.status='ENABLED'
queries.genuine_leads_by_category: SELECT segments.month, segments.conversion_action_category, metrics.conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.month
queries.campaigns: SELECT campaign.name, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.bidding_strategy_type, campaign.status FROM campaign WHERE campaign.status='ENABLED'
queries.search_terms: SELECT search_term_view.search_term, metrics.clicks FROM search_term_view WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS ORDER BY metrics.clicks DESC LIMIT 15

notes: Account A launched under PPC Guru around Feb 2026 (first data month). This is a LAUNCH story (Method B) — baseline is the first month under management (Feb 2026); 'now' is the most recent complete quarter Q2 2026 (Apr-Jun).
Genuine leads counted = PHONE_CALL_LEAD (website call + calls from ads). Lead-form and JaneApp booking actions are enabled but record no volume in the Conversions column during this window.

IMPORTANT: raw metrics.conversions is inflated from Jun 2026 by the OUTBOUND_CLICK action 'janeapp_click' (booking-button clicks): Jun raw 25 = 12 phone + 13 janeapp_click; Jul raw 33 = 7 phone + 26 janeapp_click. Genuine phone-lead counts are used throughout.
all_conversions is heavily inflated by Google Business Profile local actions (directions, menu views, website visits) — excluded.

Two enabled campaigns: a $500/day-named Physiotherapist Search campaign (Manual CPC) and a $250-named RMT Search campaign (Maximize Conversions). Approx combined monthly spend Q2 2026 ~ $555 CAD (actuals: Apr $488, May $429, Jun $748).
Confidence Medium: only ~6 months of history and phone-lead-only genuine tracking.
